description: This file defines configuration logic for API automation tests related to OrangeHRM, including environment variable loading and discovery mode settings.

classes.name: OrangeHrmApiConfig
classes.description: Class providing configuration for OrangeHRM API tests, loading parameters from environment variables, and supporting a discovery-only mode.

methods.name: fromEnv
methods.description: Creates an OrangeHrmApiConfig instance by loading environment variables and optionally requiring secrets.

methods.name: isDiscoveryOnly
methods.description: Returns whether the configuration is in discovery-only mode.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for the API.

methods.name: getAdminUsername
methods.description: Returns the admin username for the API.

methods.name: getAdminPassword
methods.description: Returns the admin password for the API.
